items.t: Engine burns oil from faulty piston rings
items.job: Replace pistons and rings (or install a replacement engine)
items.note: CarComplaints owners report an average of about $7,100. The lawsuit says a full engine replacement tops $10,000.

items.t: Fuel pump module stops working and engine stalls
items.note: The software fix under recall 09V-343 is free. CarComplaints owners report about $1,600 on average for a pump replacement.

items.t: AWD system disabled warning (Haldex pump or coupling)
items.job: Replace Haldex pump and filter, change AWD fluid
items.note: If the whole Haldex coupling or its controller is bad, parts cost much more.

items.t: Oil leaks from vacuum pump and valve cover
items.job: Reseal vacuum pump or valve cover
items.note: The low end is a vacuum pump seal kit. A valve cover reseal takes more labor.

items.t: Hissing at idle from torn PCV diaphragm
Low oil level warning from faulty dipstick
items.job: Replace oil dipstick and update engine software
items.note: Was covered under Volvo warranty; out of warranty it is a small job.

items.t: Sunroof drains clog and leak water inside
items.note: More if carpet must be dried or a drain tube replaced.

items.t: Door won't lock or unlock with the remote
12V battery drains and car won't start
items.job: Software update and 12V battery replacement if damaged
items.note: Software fixes are covered under warranty. Battery prices on newer XC60s run high at dealers.

items.t: Center screen freezes, goes black or reboots
items.job: Infotainment software reload or head unit replacement
items.note: Usually a software reload under warranty; replacing the head unit is the costly case.

items.t: Sensus touchscreen glitches and false alerts
Vibration or shudder when braking
items.job: Replace front brake pads (and rotors if needed)
